The '''Kirdo system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Tamarin sector/Legends|Tamarin sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kirdo III/Legends|Kirdo III]], homeworld of the [[Kitonak/Legends|Kitonak]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
